title: LOAD CELL,GIMBAL;NSN 3010-01-643-8616;WSDC JGN:SEAWOLF CLASSSSN;SPE4A626R0208
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEFENSE LOGISTICS AGENCY.DLA AVIATION.DLA AV RICHMOND.DLA AVIATION
detail_text: Purchase Request: 7013943837, NSN 3010-01-643-8616, Load Cell,Gimbal, Part Number: 4G10923H02 or 4G10930 Item 038. Specifications, plans or drawings relating to the procurement described are not available and cannot be furnished by the Government. DLA Aviation does not currently have an approved technical data package for this item, therefore, please do not submit requests. Approved sources for this item are Northrop Grumman Systems Corporation CAGE 31442. Any manufacturer, other than the approved source, who would like to submit a proposal on this item, must submit a complete source approval package (SAR). This solicitation will result in a firm-fixed price contract. This requirement is for 6 each. The required delivery is 260 days ARO to TRACY CA (line 0001). This is an Unrestricted Acquisition. FOB Origin, Inspection and Acceptance at Origin applies. This is not a Critical Safety Item. Supplier Performance Risk System (SPRS) applies. The final contract award decision may be based upon a combination of price, past performance and other evaluation factors as described in the solicitation. All responsible sources may submit an offer that will be considered. A copy of this solicitation will also be available to requesters by contacting the buyer directly. The estimated solicitation issue date is 05/13/2026. The anticipated closing date is 06/15/2026.
